public_messages: [Samuel Kowalski]: This data breach, affecting 2.1 million customers with exposed names, email addresses, and hashed (though unsalted) passwords, presents a serious risk.  GDPR and CCPA mandates require notification within 72 hours if material risk exists, and given the sensitive nature of the data, that threshold has clearly been crossed.  Attempting to suppress disclosure would be a blatant disregard for legal obligations and could lead to severe penalties.  Furthermore,  a delayed disclosure would likely result in greater reputational damage and erode customer trust. We must prioritize transparency and compliance by immediately notifying affected individuals and relevant authorities.
